Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class NewsletterController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.NewsletterController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1") public class NewsletterController extends Object
REST controller exposing the AI-in-Healthcare newsletter API.

Three endpoints form the two-step workflow:

  1. POST /api/v1/ingest — kick off article ingestion for a set of topics. Returns a IngestResponse with the run ID and article count.
  2. POST /api/v1/drafts — generate a newsletter draft from a completed ingestion run. Returns the full DraftResponse (201 Created).
  3. GET /api/v1/drafts/{draftId} — retrieve a previously generated draft by ID (200 OK), or 404 if the ID is unknown.

Architecture note: this controller calls only the two inbound-port interfaces (IngestArticlesUseCase and GenerateNewsletterUseCase). It never references NewsletterService, adapters, or domain repositories directly, keeping the web layer decoupled from implementation details.

Domain exceptions are mapped to HTTP status codes by GlobalExceptionHandler — this controller contains no try/catch blocks.
